name: Shadow Rage reaches the Unleash the Hounds summons as well as the Shadowhound (#311)
contract: Shadow Rage 705455 procs 804192 from Shadowblast. In the client Spell.dbc (2026-09-16) 804192 carries its haste (aura 138) and its auto-attack proc (aura 231) on effects 1 and 2 as SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS from TARGET_UNIT_CASTER with radius index 12 (100 yards): the caster's summons receive it, not one pet. Unleash the Hounds 807918 summons Lesser Shadowhound 50224 through SummonProperties 61 (category 1, type 2: a Guardian the owner controls), so it is one of those summons, like the Shadowhound 50124 from Houndmaster's Whistle 801343. Loksey's Journal 504903, a modifier of the same record (class mask B 0x1000), reads 'Shadow Rage now also grants your Shadow Hounds $s1% increased haste'. After Shadowblast every living hound the caster owns carries the caster's 804192, and the caster does not. Harvest Golem 36 is a non-fleeing target; the ratings keep Shadowblast from missing.
